theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), Measurable (fun x : Euclid P => (limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => μ (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)).toReal)
